notes: 300M maturation P2: structured-output suite — JSON validity, schema conformance, typed fields, enum membership, nested objects, arrays. Invalid output is never a positive sample (§9).

items.prompt: Output only a JSON object describing a book with fields title and author. No other text.
只輸出 JSON：{"ok": true}。不要其他文字。
Schema: {"name": string, "age": number, "vip": boolean}. Produce exactly one JSON object conforming to this schema for a 30-year-old non-vip user named Lin. Only JSON.
Return a JSON object with EXACTLY the keys id, status, score — in that order. id is an integer, status a string, score a number. Only the object.
Output JSON with fields count (integer, not string) and label (string). count=7, label=items. Only JSON.
Output JSON {"color": <value>} where value must be one of: red, green, blue. Choose green. Only JSON.
只輸出 JSON：{"priority": <值>}，值只能是 high、medium、low 其中之一。任選 medium。
Output JSON: {"user": {"name": string}, "tags": []} — user.name = "Ana", tags empty array. Only the object.
Produce nested JSON: {"order": {"id": 1, "items": [{"sku": "A1"}]}}. Follow this shape exactly. Only JSON.
Output JSON {"numbers": [1,2,3]} exactly. Only the JSON object.
只輸出 JSON：{"fruits": [<三種水果的字串陣列>]}，填入蘋果、香蕉、芒果。
Emit the literal JSON {"type":"result","value":42} verbatim — no extra keys, no text.
